title: Keith's loggia carved as the 1888 photograph shows it
items: At 1808 Prairie, each pair of entrance columns now shares one carved Ionic capital, rolled into volutes. The balcony above sits level on a deep cornice, with a stepped stone finial on its stair-side corner.
Both stone stair cheeks now end at the street in a rolled scroll foot. The bow's second-floor windows are taller, reaching up under its moulded cap as they do in the 1888 plate.
